thread:
mira: dropped narrow-rows mock for the rules editor; aim to reduce vertical bloat. https://img.redwood/mock/narrow-rows.png
oscar: looks promising. main concern: where do validation errors show when rows are reduced? they disappear in the mock.
jenny: show a tiny error chip inline (color + 1-2 words) and surface full message in the preview panel when expanded.
tony: accessibility: reveal details without moving keyboard focus. use aria-expanded on the row header and animate height only.
a11y-bot: contrast check failed for error chip (ratio 3.6:1). recommend danger-700 bg or white text with heavier weight.
oscar: reordering note: keyboard move needs announcements. live region: "Moved to position 2 of 8". also support single-key move up/down.
mira: thinking of a compact rank badge left of the title that becomes a drag handle on hover to save space.
jenny: keep badge visible by default; add a preference to hide for super-compact mode.
tony: copy tweak for the preview CTA: change "Run Preview" -> "Simulate" and microcopy beneath: "Uses cached prefixes; toggle full-run for cold-starts."
mira: i'll update the Figma with rank badge + error chip + simulate copy and post v2 later today.
oscar: quick test plan: contrast audit, keyboard reorder announcement, chip discoverability with screen reader, drag target size at 1024/1280 breakpoints.
